descriptions.interaction: GPS-based exploration of nearby places and linked photos/reviews; users can publish location/photo/review data linked to places.
descriptions.guidance: Geographic/current-location entry point and contextual place media/reviews; no adaptive recommendation mechanism established.
descriptions.visualisation: Map-based mobile display and place detail (Figure2).
descriptions.backend: RDF/Linked Data DBpedia resources, Revyu and Flickr-wrapper interlinks; broader SPARQL context explained.
